name: illustrator
title_zh: 在 Illustrator 里直接改版式
tagline_zh: 写代码的人也能动 .ai 主文件：调字阶、排画板、换色板、理图层，全走 MCP 指令。
tagline_en: For coders who must touch .ai files: set type scales, arrange artboards, swap swatches, manage layers—all via MCP.
desc_en: Vector graphics authoring, artboard layout management, typographic hierarchy, color swatches, layer manipulation, and automated diagram/plate production via Adobe Illustrator MCP server. Use when the user asks to inspect, manipulate, create, style, or export Adobe Illustrator documents (.ai/.eps/.pdf/.svg), or mentions /illustrator, "illustrator", or ".ai master file". Do NOT use for general Artif
why_zh: 它把 Illustrator 的 DOM 操作变成可编程接口，不是截图模拟点击。版式、字阶、色板。
why_en: It exposes Illustrator's document model as a programmable API—no fragile UI automation. Precise control over type, artboards.
limit_zh: 必须本机装有 Adobe Illustrator 并开启 MCP 服务；只覆盖矢量文档的版式/图层/色板/导出。
limit_en: Requires local Adobe Illustrator with MCP server running. Covers vector layout/layers/swatches/export only—no raster FX, 3D, or complex filters. AI.
title_en: Drive Illustrator layout, layers & swatches without.
